description: This file defines the SNFeaturesService class, which manages feature-related functionalities such as fetching, enabling/disabling experimental features, handling offline features, and reacting to events within the Standard Notes application.

classes.name: SNFeaturesService
classes.description: A service class managing features, including fetching, enabling/disabling, offline handling, and event responses within the application.

methods.name: initializeFromDisk
methods.description: Loads roles, features, and experimental features from persistent storage.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles internal events, particularly MetaReceived events, to update roles and fetch features.

methods.name: handleApplicationStage
methods.description: Performs actions based on application stage, such as mapping features to items after full sync.

methods.name: mapClientControlledFeaturesToItems
methods.description: Maps client-controlled features to items in the app.

methods.name: enableExperimentalFeature
methods.description: Enables a specified experimental feature and maps it to items if applicable.

methods.name: disableExperimentalFeature
methods.description: Disables a specified experimental feature and deletes associated items.

methods.name: toggleExperimentalFeature
methods.description: Toggles the state of an experimental feature.

methods.name: getExperimentalFeatures
methods.description: Returns the list of all experimental features.

methods.name: isExperimentalFeature
methods.description: Checks if a feature is part of the experimental features list.

methods.name: getEnabledExperimentalFeatures
methods.description: Returns the list of currently enabled experimental features.

methods.name: isExperimentalFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific experimental feature is enabled.

methods.name: setOfflineFeaturesCode
methods.description: Sets offline features using an activation code, decoding and parsing it, then downloading features.

methods.name: getOfflineRepo
methods.description: Retrieves the offline feature repository if exists.

methods.name: hasOfflineRepo
methods.description: Checks if an offline feature repository exists.

methods.name: deleteOfflineFeatureRepo
methods.description: Deletes the offline feature repository and clears related stored features.

methods.name: parseOfflineEntitlementsCode
methods.description: Parses an offline entitlements code into features URL and extension key.

methods.name: downloadOfflineFeatures
methods.description: Downloads offline features from a repository and updates roles.

methods.name: migrateFeatureRepoToUserSetting
methods.description: Migrates feature repositories to user settings.

methods.name: migrateFeatureRepoToOfflineEntitlements
methods.description: Migrates feature repositories to offline entitlements.

methods.name: hasFirstPartyOnlineSubscription
methods.description: Checks if user has a first-party online subscription.

methods.name: hasFirstPartySubscription
methods.description: Checks if user has a first-party subscription, offline or online.

methods.name: updateOnlineRoles
methods.description: Updates online roles and triggers role change events.

methods.name: fetchFeatures
methods.description: Fetches features from server if roles have changed or initial load.

methods.name: setOnlineRoles
methods.description: Sets online roles and triggers role change event if roles differ.

methods.name: setOfflineRoles
methods.description: Sets offline roles and triggers role change event if roles differ.

methods.name: didDownloadFeatures
methods.description: Processes downloaded features, filters, maps, and updates storage.

methods.name: isThirdPartyFeature
methods.description: Checks if a feature is third-party (not native).

methods.name: mapRemoteNativeFeatureToStaticFeature
methods.description: Maps remote feature description to static native feature.

methods.name: getFeatureThatOriginallyCameFromServer
methods.description: Retrieves a feature that was originally fetched from server.

methods.name: onlineRolesIncludePaidSubscription
methods.description: Checks if online roles include paid subscription roles.

methods.name: hasPaidAnyPartyOnlineOrOfflineSubscription
methods.description: Checks if user has any paid subscription, online or offline.

methods.name: rolesBySorting
methods.description: Sorts roles based on predefined role hierarchy.

methods.name: hasMinimumRole
methods.description: Checks if user roles include at least a specified role.

methods.name: isFeatureDeprecated
methods.description: Checks if a feature is deprecated.

methods.name: isFreeFeature
methods.description: Checks if a feature is free.

methods.name: getFeatureStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of a feature based on subscriptions, deprecation, and expiration.

methods.name: componentContentForNativeFeatureDescription
methods.description: Creates component content from a native feature description.

methods.name: mapRemoteNativeFeaturesToItems
methods.description: Maps remote native features to app items.

methods.name: mapRemoteNativeFeatureToItem
methods.description: Maps a single remote native feature to an app item, handling creation, update, or deletion.

methods.name: downloadExternalFeature
methods.description: Downloads an external feature by URL or code, with trust verification.

methods.name: performDownloadExternalFeature
methods.description: Performs the actual download of an external feature from a URL.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up observers and references for garbage collection.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Returns diagnostic information about the service state.
